defect: Cargo nextest discovery can atomically replace the running native xtask. Rechecking current_exe on Linux sees its deleted old pathname, so docs run without count interception after nextest was counted.
fix: Freeze the verified native controller role at process startup in private OnceLock; reject missing markers without filesystem lookup; retain both accepted and rejected roles through executable-path changes.
real_regression: Copied actual native controller, transparent mise wrapper, pinned Rust nextest/list and Cargo doctests. Wrapper copies then atomically renames the admitted executable during real list; successful receipt must count both producer completions.
red_then_green: Old code yields successful3/2/1 receipt and permits a rejected test carrier to gain admission through path retargeting; fixed code yields5/3/2 with two completion pairs and keeps carrier rejected.
validated: framework and system scoped clippy with -D warnings
scope_unchanged: No Model, guest-driver, lease, scheduler, budget, retry or Go-adapter changes.
